comments.text: The 'big parks' are way too expensive for the average family.  I live near Knobels Grove (do yourself a favor and google it).  This place has free admission, free parking,  the best food in any park (golden ticket award repeatedly), and you can even bring your own food and picnic for free.  You can even bring your friendly dog!  You can buy books of tickets and ride what you like and not pay for the rest of the park.  I don't work there.  I am not a paid rep.  I am just a PA proud person who wants to share a fantastic secret with families who need a good time without a second mortgage.  Oh, Trip Advisor just rated them as the best park in America (2026), beating Disney, Universal, Dollywood, everyone else, period.  Hershey tried to buy them and got told to take a hike.  This place is family owned and is celebrating its 100th anniversary this year.  And to make it even more all American their opening day was July 4th.  Check out the Knobels history museum while you are there for the whole story, and yes, it's free to get in.
